description: This file defines the AddOnStoreSearchView class, a custom UI component extending FrameLayout, used for displaying a search view in the add-on store of the application. It includes methods to set the title and attach a search controller for handling search actions.

classes.name: AddOnStoreSearchView
classes.description: A custom UI component for the add-on store search interface, allowing setting of title and search controller.

methods.name: AddOnStoreSearchView
methods.description: Constructor that inflates the layout for the search view.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title text in the search view.

methods.name: setSearchController
methods.description: Attaches a search controller to handle search actions when the view is clicked.
